title: unified-rollouts-proactive-shadow-canary-autorollback-workflow
author: Mei Chen
description: Context: This PR implements a proactive shadow-canary automated rollback workflow in the unified rollouts engine. Motivation: allow model lifecycle to surface regressions earlier by shipping staged shadow traffic probing and automatic rollback decisions before heavy production traffic shifts. What changed: 1) added a new AutorollbackWorkflow controller that coordinates staged shadow probing + canary traffic phases; 2) extended the rollout scheduler to support proactive probing windows and composite metric quorums; 3) added observability and e2e tests. Checklist: - [x] design doc linked (ENG-4021) - [x] unit + integration tests - [x] e2e test harness - [x] metrics and alerts - [x] documentation updates Testing notes: local unit and integration on linux/amd64; e2e tests ran in CI against simulated model endpoints with fault injection. Rollout behavior: default is opt-in per-rollout via rollout.spec.proactiveShadow.enabled and tuned with rollout.spec.probing.windowMs and rollout.spec.autorollback.metricQuorum. Safety: early-exit safety guards added (max-probing-duration, quorum-thresholds) to avoid noisy autoscaling or false positives. Backwards compatibility: new fields are additive and gated by feature flag. See changed files for implementation highlights and small examples in docs/rollouts/proactive_shadow_canary.md
